csv_scope_of_work: These professional services are primarily for Airport Improvement Program (AIP) and Passenger Facility Charge (PFC) funded airport capital improvement projects. Anticipated projects include: runway, taxiway and apron pavement (PCC concrete and asphalt) rehabilitation, construction of cargo aprons, safety area improvements, airfield geometry changes, airfield lighting upgrades, storm water improvements, roadway construction, utility infrastructure, environmental documentation, security fence and gate, Safety Risk Management facilitator services, AGIS survey services, equipment specifications, Architectural design services, and other Engineering services as needed. Boise Airport Five Year Engineering Services
